# vendor

## mediaremote-adapter

- Source: https://github.com/ungive/mediaremote-adapter
- Version: commit `0e82bf1` (17.10.2026, "Sort projects alphabetically"), copied without its `.git` folder.
- Licence: BSD-3-Clause, see `mediaremote-adapter/LICENSE`. Keep it in every copy.
- Local changes: none. Do not edit this folder.
- Updating: replace the folder with a newer copy of upstream, run `scripts/build-adapter.sh`, check `test` and `get`
  while TIDAL plays, then write the new commit here.
